architecture.summary: PR 3 of the habit-hooks cleanup stack corrects each remaining enforced habit-hooks finding in code, and the advisory non-null assertions, without a change of behavior: 51 high-complexity, 29 too-many-parameters, 4 oversized-function, 1 oversized-file, and 35 non-null-assertion findings at the parent. Functions get named steps, values that travel together become one value, and workos-organizations.ts (448 lines) keeps WorkOSOrganizations (262 lines) and moves its answer rules, invitations, and membership reads to three modules of the same workos component. Two declarations of public modules change (fact d), so internalInterface is set. DestinationSettingsService.test of audit-logs takes the tenant and the actor as one TestRequester value; its one production caller, the Audit logs route of web, builds it from the same trusted Admin context as before. The WebsiteFetchLaunchError constructor of website-fetcher derives its launch diagnostic from its cause instead of an optional parameter; its one production caller passed that same value. No component, dependency edge, public module, external dependency, client contract, composition, build output, or deployment relationship changes. The security files workos-signup.ts and css-animation-declarations.ts keep the same checks in the same order. The component registry describes components and their collaboration, not files or signatures; its prose and all 21 views remain accurate and unchanged.
